name: Webaaty – AI Chat Assistant
author: ifdev

sections.description:
Webaaty adds an AI chat assistant to your WordPress site — an AI chatbot that answers your visitors 24/7, captures leads, and can show a WhatsApp, Messenger and multi-channel contact button. It’s powered by Chaaty, trained on your own website content, and goes live in minutes with no coding.

Unlike a scripted chatbot, Webaaty’s assistant understands natural questions and answers from your business — your pages, files and Q&A — so replies are accurate, on-brand, and available around the clock.

How it works

  1. Create a free Chaaty account (no credit card).
  2. Build your assistant in the Chaaty dashboard — train it on your site, set its look, languages and channels.
  3. Connect it in WordPress by pasting your Chatbot ID. Webaaty injects the widget for you — no theme editing.

What’s included on the Free plan

The free plan is genuinely useful on its own. It includes:

  • AI chatbot with top-tier AI intelligence, unlimited chats & users
  • Trains on your website content, files & Q&A, with auto-generated instructions
  • Remembers customers by name and formats responses for readability
  • Quick replies and 16 languages supported
  • Display triggers & targeting (time, scroll, exit-intent; by page, country, source, business hours, campaign dates)
  • Greeting cards with animations, customizable greeting & display
  • Seamless experience between pages, auto-close inactive chats, follow-up messages, return to last message, notification badge
  • Custom avatar & name, icon library, flexible bubble positioning
  • 6 adaptive themes, large font library, ready-to-use templates, responsive layout, page-speed-friendly loading
  • Custom CSS & JS editors, legal notice field
  • Emails chat transcripts
  • Free plan shows a “Powered by Chaaty” badge (removable on paid plans)

Free plan limits: 1 chatbot, 50 AI messages/month, 200 widget views/month.

What you unlock on Paid plans

Everything in Free, plus:

  • Remove the “Powered by Chaaty” branding
  • Contact channels / contact button — WhatsApp, Call, SMS, Email, Messenger, Telegram, Instagram, Directions and custom links, as an in-chat action bar or a floating channels launcher
  • Standalone widget modes — chat only, chat + channels, or channels only
  • Lead capture (lead generation) — collects visitor name & email right in the conversation
  • Bookings — let visitors schedule appointments inside the chat
  • Zapier, Make & webhook integrations & API
  • Telegram human handoff — get and reply to visitor chats from Telegram
  • Advanced customizations, multiple projects & collaborators
  • Priority support, 100% ad-free, and higher limits (more chatbots, messages and views)

Paid plans start low, and agency / white-label plans are available for resellers. See chaaty.io for current pricing.

Great for small businesses, e-commerce, agencies, service providers, clinics, restaurants, real estate and SaaS — anyone who wants an AI chatbot, live chat widget, WhatsApp contact button, lead-generation chat or customer-support assistant.

You need a free Chaaty account. Chaaty is a hosted (SaaS) service.

External services

This plugin connects your site to Chaaty, a third-party service operated by Chaaty (https://chaaty.io). The connection is required because the chat assistant is hosted and processed by Chaaty.

What the plugin does:

  • It loads the Chaaty widget script from https://chaaty.io/widget/embed.js on the front end of your site (only when you have entered a Chatbot ID and the assistant is enabled).
  • When a visitor interacts with the assistant, their messages and related session data are sent to Chaaty (https://chaaty.io) to generate replies and, where enabled, capture leads or bookings. This happens in the visitor’s browser via the loaded widget.
  • The plugin sends your Chatbot ID (which you provide) to identify which assistant to load.

The plugin itself does not send your visitors’ data to any other service. Data handling by Chaaty is governed by its policies:

  • Terms of Service: https://chaaty.io/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://chaaty.io/privacy

If you remove the plugin or disable the assistant, the widget script is no longer loaded on your site.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → Webaaty and click Create free account (or connect an existing Chaaty account).
  3. In your Chaaty dashboard, build your assistant and copy its Chatbot ID (the value of data-chatbot-id in the embed code).
  4. Paste the Chatbot ID in Settings → Webaaty and save.
  5. Visit your site — the assistant is live. Choose which pages it appears on right from the settings screen.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account?

Yes. Webaaty connects your site to Chaaty, a hosted service. Create a free account at https://chaaty.io, build your assistant, and paste its Chatbot ID into the plugin.

Is it free?

The plugin is free, and Chaaty offers a free plan. Paid Chaaty plans add more messages and views, lead capture, bookings, integrations, extra contact channels and branding removal.

Where do I find my Chatbot ID?

In your Chaaty dashboard, open your chatbot and view its embed code. The Chatbot ID is the value of the data-chatbot-id attribute. Paste just that value.

Can it use my own website content?

Yes. In Chaaty you train the assistant on your website, files and Q&A, so it answers from your actual business.

Can I add a WhatsApp or Messenger contact button?

Yes, on a paid plan. Contact channels (WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram, Instagram, SMS, call, email, directions, custom links) are configured on your assistant in Chaaty and appear in the widget the plugin loads.

Where does the assistant appear, and can I control that?

By default it shows on every page. In Settings → Webaaty you can choose to hide it on specific pages by slug or ID.

How do I remove it from my site?

Turn off “Show on site” in Settings → Webaaty, or deactivate the plugin. Either stops the widget from loading.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New guided setup: create a free account, build your assistant, and connect it — all explained in the plugin.
  • Added page targeting: choose to show the assistant everywhere or hide it on specific pages.
  • Connection status panel and quick links to customize your assistant.
  • Rewritten, clearer onboarding so new users know exactly what to do.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: add your Chaaty AI assistant to WordPress with a single setting.
